characters.name: Oliver Queen
characters.bio: Five years on a hell of an island made him a weapon. Now he protects Star City from the rooftops.

characters.name: Barry Allen
characters.bio: Struck by lightning from a particle accelerator, Barry became the Fastest Man Alive.

characters.name: Kara Zor-El
characters.bio: Kal-El's cousin from Krypton, National City's protector, and a reporter at CatCo.

characters.name: Clark Kent
characters.bio: The Man of Steel. Farm boy, father, and the strongest hero on any Earth.

characters.name: Ray Palmer
characters.bio: A billionaire genius in an exo-suit that can fly, fire blasts and shrink to the size of an atom.

characters.name: Sara Lance
characters.bio: Trained by the League of Assassins, captain of the Waverider. Brings a bo staff to every fight.

characters.name: Laurel Lance
characters.bio: Lawyer by day, vigilante by night, with a sonic device that knocks enemies off their feet.

characters.name: John Diggle
characters.bio: Ex-soldier, Oliver's brother-in-arms, and the steadiest man in Team Arrow.

characters.name: Thea Queen
characters.bio: Oliver's sister, trained by Malcolm Merlyn. Quick, fierce and unpredictable.

characters.name: Wally West
characters.bio: Joe West's son and Barry's protege. Possibly the fastest of them all.

characters.name: Cisco Ramon
characters.bio: S.T.A.R. Labs engineer who can see across the multiverse and open breaches between worlds.

characters.name: Caitlin Snow
characters.bio: Doctor, metahuman, and the coolest head in the room. Literally.

characters.name: Jefferson Jackson
characters.bio: A nuclear man formed by merging two people. Flies, burns, and transmutes matter.

characters.name: J'onn J'onzz
characters.bio: Last son of Mars and director of the DEO. A shapeshifter with the strength of a Kryptonian.

characters.name: Kate Kane
characters.bio: Bruce Wayne's cousin picks up the cowl to protect Gotham, and anywhere else that needs it.

characters.name: Jefferson Pierce
characters.bio: A high-school principal who returns to the streets of Freeland with the power of electricity.

characters.name: Anissa Pierce
characters.bio: Jefferson's daughter. Controls her density to become nearly unbreakable and hit like a freight train.

characters.name: Jennifer Pierce
characters.bio: Generates pure energy. Flies on it, throws it, and occasionally overloads with it.

characters.name: Curtis Holt
characters.bio: Olympic decathlete and tech genius, armed with floating T-Spheres.

characters.name: Mari McCabe
characters.bio: Channels the abilities of any animal through the Tantu Totem.

characters.name: Kendra Saunders
characters.bio: An Egyptian priestess reborn across millennia, with Nth-metal wings and a mace.

characters.name: Nate Heywood
characters.bio: A historian who can turn his whole body into living steel.

characters.name: Courtney Whitmore
characters.bio: A teenager who inherited the Cosmic Staff, and the legacy of the JSA with it.

characters.name: Jay Garrick
characters.bio: The original Flash of Earth-3, complete with winged helmet and decades of experience.

characters.name: Jesse Wells
characters.bio: Harrison Wells' daughter from Earth-2, who got her speed from the same accelerator.

characters.name: Nora West-Allen
characters.bio: Barry and Iris' daughter from the future, with a purple tint to her lightning.

characters.name: Ralph Dibny
characters.bio: A private eye with a body like rubber. Long reach, big mouth, bigger heart.

characters.name: James Olsen
characters.bio: Photographer turned armored vigilante, with a shield that doubles as a battering ram.

characters.name: Mon-El
characters.bio: A Daxamite prince who found his heroism on Earth, and later in the 31st century.

characters.name: Nia Nal
characters.bio: The first trans superhero on TV. She sees the future in her dreams and fires dream energy.

characters.name: Querl Dox
characters.bio: A 12th-level intellect from the 31st century, Legion of Super-Heroes member.

characters.name: Roy Harper
characters.bio: Raised in the Glades, trained by Oliver, and the closest thing Team Arrow has to a little brother.

characters.name: Rene Ramirez
characters.bio: A former marine from the Glades with a hockey mask and no patience.

characters.name: Mick Rory
characters.bio: A pyromaniac thief who became a Legend. He still loves to watch things burn.

characters.name: Malcolm Merlyn
characters.bio: The man behind the Undertaking, and later Ra's al Ghul himself.

characters.name: Slade Wilson
characters.bio: A soldier supercharged by the Mirakuru, out for revenge on the man he trained.

characters.name: Adrian Chase
characters.bio: Star City's District Attorney and its most patient serial killer.

characters.name: Damien Darhk
characters.bio: Leader of H.I.V.E. who wields a mystical idol's dark magic.

characters.name: Eobard Thawne
characters.bio: The Flash's greatest enemy, a speedster from the 25th century who hates Barry Allen.

characters.name: Hunter Zolomon
characters.bio: The speed demon of Earth-2. Wants every ounce of speed in the multiverse.

characters.name: Savitar
characters.bio: The self-proclaimed god of speed, encased in a towering suit of armor.

characters.name: Clifford DeVoe
characters.bio: The smartest man alive, who wants to reset humanity from his hover chair.

characters.name: Leonard Snart
characters.bio: A master thief with a cold gun and a plan for everything.

characters.name: Mick Rory
characters.bio: Snart's partner in crime and in fire.

characters.name: Mark Mardon
characters.bio: A meta who controls the weather and holds a grudge against the CCPD.

characters.name: Samantha Arias
characters.bio: A Worldkiller from Krypton's darkest legend. Judge, jury and executioner.

characters.name: Lex Luthor
characters.bio: Genius, billionaire, and the most dangerous man alive, in his warsuit.

characters.name: Ra's al Ghul
characters.bio: The immortal head of the League of Assassins.

characters.name: Orlin Dwyer
characters.bio: A metahuman hunter with a power-dampening lightning dagger.

characters.name: Gorilla Grodd
characters.bio: A telepathic super-gorilla who wants Gorilla City to rule the world.

characters.name: Vandal Savage
characters.bio: An immortal tyrant who has killed Hawkgirl and Hawkman across four thousand years.

characters.name: Laurel Lance (Earth-2)
characters.bio: Earth-2's Laurel, a metahuman whose cry can shatter concrete.

characters.name: Ricardo Diaz
characters.bio: A Glades kid who became Star City's kingpin.

characters.name: Alice
characters.bio: Kate Kane's twin sister and the mad queen of Gotham's underworld.

characters.name: Digger Harkness
characters.bio: A former A.S.I.S. agent with a grudge and a bag of explosive boomerangs.

characters.name: Mobius
characters.bio: The being of antimatter who erased the multiverse in the Crisis.

characters.name: Overgirl
characters.bio: Earth-X's Kara, the Kryptonian enforcer of a tyrannical regime.

characters.name: Oliver Queen (Earth-X)
characters.bio: Earth-X's Oliver, dictator of a world where tyranny won.

characters.name: Tobias Whale
characters.bio: Freeland's ruthless crime boss, leader of the 100 gang.
